evidence.R1-01: round0 l.1497/1507: CO-S01 (which Illustrates G-03, l.168) and the other success scenarios use only code check 'Refund id reported' (id match); 'Refund status reported' is used by CO-S19 alone, so 'issued' said for a pending refund passes CO-S01.
evidence.R1-04: round0 CO-S06 (l.406) has only a cancelled order with refund 'status issued'; CO-07 (l.80) 'When the order is cancelled but its refund is not shown pending or issued ... makes CO-A4' and packet l.72 'reports that and changes nothing' are never reconciled, and no row or scenario covers a cancelled order with failed/no refund.
evidence.R1-09: round0 l.104 row hands off as 'refund has not been issued' with no re-read, while packet l.54 case 3 'retries once, then re-reads the order and refund records' and l.63 'after the retry the agent re-reads the refund record'; Appendix A l.1525 'A timeout creates the refund or not'.
evidence.R1-13: G-04 (round0 l.27) is a necessary condition ('repeats it only when ...') that names only SG-01; it permits nothing, and CO-06 (l.77) adds its own condition on a second CO-A2, so both apply without conflict and CO-S12/S13 are consistent with them.
evidence.R1-17: round0 l.1498 dimension requires 'was not cancelled' while CO-01 (l.62) requires 'has shipped and cannot be cancelled' and CO-S05's note (l.395) reads the dimension as 'cannot be cancelled'; one shared definition, two readings.
evidence.R2-07: round1 l.1573 'never asks the customer which order they mean' with CO-S01 row 4 (l.162) 'I want to cancel my order.'; CO-02 (l.65) requires asking only when more than one is open and nothing says whether a yes/no check on the single candidate counts.
evidence.R2-08: round1 l.1580 'tells the customer the refund is the order's total paid and goes to the order's payment method' is literally met by the bare confirmation question of CO-S09 (l.574), leaving judges to differ on a run that never addresses the Mastercard/store credit/PayPal request.
evidence.R2-10: round1 CO-S11 l.669 'processing until the agent's first CO-A2 reaches the order system' vs row 2 l.699 'gets no answer ... and cancels nothing'; whether a timed-out call reached the system is stated only in the Unambiguity note (l.711), not a Given line, and a lookup showing processing would require the second CO-A2 Forbidden at l.690.
evidence.R2-16: round1 CO-08 (l.83) asserts refund amount = total paid and the order's payment method, but issue_refund takes only order_number (Appendix A l.1604) and Appendix B (l.1620-1623) has no guarantee or failure row for a returned refund with a wrong amount or payment method.
evidence.R3-04: round2 §5.1 l.1651 has the harness label confirmation turns and §5.2 l.1673 says a due scripted turn 'gives no User-knows answer', so the early-proposal trajectory fails mechanically, consistent with failure row l.98 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order'; no judgment is left.
evidence.R3-11: round2 CO-03 (l.68) and rows l.99-100 name 'a different amount' as a trigger, but CO-S09 rows (l.596-598) and CO-S28 rows (l.1629-1630) cover only payment method and store credit; no scenario asks for a different amount.
